queries_run: Live Nation Ticketmaster business model shift distribution channel 2026

findings.claim: 報導稱 DOJ 和解要求 Ticketmaster 開放第三方使用其技術系統售票（二手報導，需 Tunney Act 核准）
findings.excerpt: Ticketmaster will be required to enable third parties to use its technology system to offer tickets.

findings.claim: 同報導稱和解將 Live Nation 長期獨家合約上限訂為四年
findings.excerpt: The agreement caps Live Nation's long-term exclusivity contracts at four years

findings.claim: Q2 2026 財報新聞稿列出與 Spotify Reserved 的售票合作，利用 Ticketmaster 平台
findings.excerpt: New ticket access partnership with Spotify's Reserved leverages Ticketmaster's platform to help more fans access tickets

findings.claim: 10-K 稱 Ticketmaster 2025 年經多通路（行動、線上、聯盟夥伴）配售 6.46 億張票，並以擴大非服務費收入為方向
findings.excerpt: We are focused on selling tickets through a wide set of sales channels including mobile, online and affiliate partners while continuing to broaden our digital rollout.

channel_business_model_shift.note: 通路轉變主要由反壟斷和解驅動；未見訂閱化或 D2C 轉型證據。
